<p>Today, we are going to review the past week of football moments demonstrating character, the love of the game and, unfortunately...a little bit about peeing thanks to tx defensive end colin simmons who earned a 15-yard unsportsmanlike penalty on third down, because he celebrated sacking the tennessee qb by “simulating using the restroom” which gave&nbsp;the volatiles a first down erasing the effort of his sack…brilliant move, colin.&nbsp;</p><p><a href="https://x.com/haterreport/status/2103904639708237938?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://x.com/haterreport/status/2103904639708237938?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA</a></p><p>Only thing to love about that scenario is the reminder it provides that on our worst day we may actually be more composed than many college football players. It should comfort us to know that when things are going our way there’s no tendency to rejoice our pleasure in life by doing something mildly obscene? Feels good to know we have grown, doesn’t it?!</p><p>And, also, look how adult we all are when things go awry and we want to punch our boss, coworker or object of our frustration but we resist, because it could get us dismissed like gamecock defensive end dylan stewart going after <em>UA one-handed-catch-wonder</em> Josh Ford…</p><p><a href="https://x.com/no3sports/status/2104202138620657884?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://x.com/no3sports/status/2104202138620657884?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA</a></p><p>But not all memorable collegiate moves from this past weekend decry a need for counseling…such as Trinidad Chambless out-maturing all of us by waiting for florida coach sumrall to finish his television&nbsp;interview to congratulate him on his victory over ole miss! That is impressive…</p><p><a href="https://x.com/jason_hamby14/status/2103991385439494477?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://x.com/jason_hamby14/status/2103991385439494477?s=46&amp;t=XbZxpV7Nr8sroVf69IdfSA</a></p><p>What a champ this guy is. Makes you feel all warm and fuzzy inside…and even better when we feel the jolt of karma only college football can deliver with Iowa bumping off michigan with a TD pass on the final play of the game as soooo excited student shares on Hawkeye radio broadcast:</p><p><a href="https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1BqhnUuLT9/?mibextid=wwXIfr" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1BqhnUuLT9/?mibextid=wwXIfr</a></p><p>Everybody is sharing the love with this nice shout out from a Hawkeye to Western Michigan and outstanding social media work by the Iowa sports information department.&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64,">                                      <img src="data:image/png;base64,"> </p><p>But check out the emotion and real tears of pride and joy in Iowa Coach Kirk Ferentz’s eyes (longest tenured FBS coach with 28 years at Iowa and he still gets moved by a win). LOVE IT!</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64,"></p><p>Iowa faces ohio st this weekend…home of the new Heisman favorite wide receiver jeremiah smith. If Iowa can somehow win the game, they will be a playoff team!</p><p>We see even more reasons to love football season in Wake Forest Coach Jake Dickert’s emotional reaction to pulling off a victory against Louisville (sorry about this to my Louisville grad brother, John). Dickert gets visibly choked up not only about the win but also for being at the game instead of with his sweet wife who lost her father…</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64,"></p><p>These fellows remind us of all that is right with the world and what really matters in life…like Alabama fans ability to pray and moan enough about the Tide not showing up in the first half of the game this season…only to work it in the first half against south cackalacky and then begin to fade in the second half?! Obviously, we Tide fans need to get our priorities straight and keep the complaints and prayer requests consistent this week about the <em>entire</em> game…especially since many of us mistakenly thought our upcoming game against ms st would be no more than playing with puppies before facing the georgia bulldogs in two weeks! ms st is a legit challenge! Listen up everybody, this is serious stuff…everyone has to do their part and commit to washing your lucky undies<em> twice </em>this week to ensure <em>two halves </em>of play on the field!</p><p>It’s another great weekend of football to enjoy with family and friends...though not all of it will be pleasant to watch. Poor dabo is facing miami (eek) and there is a major <em>VBB</em> before us. For those of you new to the Wuskaloosa Report, what is a <em>VBB </em>you may ask? That’s a <em>Vomit Bucket Bowl…</em>a game that requires the purchase of a vomit bucket, because Alabama fans cannot help but regurgitate a little every time they accidentally celebrate a touchdown or field goal achieved by either team. This Saturday’s <em>VBB</em> is between the aubs and tenn?!
